statements: Base table declarations and exactly one ordinary view named result; no properties, defaults, generated values, foreign keys or UDF declarations.
identifiers: Case-preserving names with no case-insensitive collisions within relations, each base table's columns, or the declared view's outputs.

windows.arithmetic: signed integer microseconds; negative epoch floor by normalized remainder
windows.intervals: Positive whole-number day/hour/minute/second literal, at most one day; no offset, fractional, compound or month/year intervals
windows.hop: size is a multiple of slide; at most 100 memberships

output.semantics: SQL bag; no output ordering guarantee
output.schema: Declared Feldera view column names/types and RelRoot projection mapping
output.aggregate_types: explicit cast to the typed Feldera result; overflow fails
